subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the remaining TUI work be docs/help for the current pi-tui newline behavior only, or should OpenClaw expose a supported user-configurable send/newline keybinding surface for openclaw tui?
rationale: Current main already has dependency-backed multiline insertion, but a configurable preference would add public TUI config/API surface under repository policy that sets a high bar for new options.

options.title: Document Current Behavior
options.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Define a narrow keybinding config or CLI surface with docs and tests for default and customized send/newline behavior.

options.title: Split Broader Composer Work
options.body: Keep this issue focused on TUI docs/help and route WebChat shortcut, external-editor, expanded-composer, or vim-mode requests to their separate trackers.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior
recommendation.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed this exact issue and have the strongest current TUI docs/help/editor wrapper history signal.
